_comentario: MODELO TEENS. Aula IMPAR = modelo de FALA (REGRA 29): dialogo line-by-line + 3 role-plays guided/semi-free/free, sem texto central de leitura. Vozes iguais as aulas 1-6: 'ellen' remapeada para voz de adolescente (12 anos), 'candy' para a segunda voz jovem (Ruby), 'arthur' intocado para as palavras soltas do Word Arena e para o adulto do listening 2. DOIS grids de vocab (4+4): o revealVocab do shell teens so conhece vocabGrid1 e vocabGrid2. NIVEL B2 por ordem do Dan (09/09/2026, re-nivelamento da aula 4 em diante); o chip do header segue 'B1' como nas aulas 4, 5 e 6, que e o campo humano do cadastro. Ponte tematica combinada na aula 6: da escola para os lugares da cidade, com callback do vocab da 6 no warm-up.

lesson.menu_desc: A friend arrives with a list of eleven places and half of them are a waste of an afternoon -- the words that put something at the top of everything you have ever seen -- 27 slides
lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- The Best Thing About It
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Sophia | Lesson 7 -- The Best Thing About It
lesson.grammar_point: superlatives with present perfect (the best I have ever, by far, one of the)

listenings.text: Right, you asked me to rank my own city, so here it is, and nobody is going to like it. The most overrated thing here, by a mile, is the big wheel by the river. You pay more than you would for lunch, you go up for twenty minutes, and what you actually see is roofs. That is it. Roofs. Meanwhile, the best thing I have ever eaten in this city costs almost nothing and comes out of a van behind the bus station. It is a cheese sandwich. I am completely serious. There is a queue of taxi drivers at seven in the morning and they are never wrong about food. So the rule I would give you is this one. Ask somebody who lives there, not the internet. The places with the most photos are almost never the best ones. They are just the easiest ones to photograph, which is a completely different thing.

And we are back, and today you have been telling us about the most overrated places in this city, and honestly, some of you are angry. Priya writes: I waited two hours outside that famous ice cream shop in July, two hours, in the sun, and it was the biggest letdown of my year. The ice cream was fine. Fine is not worth two hours, Priya says, and I think most of us agree with her. Then Marcus writes in to defend the old tower, which everybody on this programme keeps attacking. He says yes, it is touristy, yes, the gift shop is ridiculous, but it is still worth it, because it is the only place in the city where you see the river and the hills at the same time. That is a fair point and I am giving it to him. Tomorrow we turn it around: send me the most underrated place in this city. One message each, and give me a reason, not just a name.

items.situation: Somebody asks what the best thing in this city is. Do not answer with nice or good -- put one place at the top of everything you have ever seen.
tips: It's the best view I've ever seen, and I've been up a lot of buildings.
It's easily the best museum I've ever been to in this country.

items.situation: A visitor wants to go to the place with the most photos online. Tell them it is overrated -- and say by how much.
tips: It's by far the most overrated street here, and it isn't close.
It's touristy from one end to the other. I'd cross it off.

items.situation: Your friend asks whether a forty-minute line is worth it. Answer, and give one reason she can argue with.
tips: Yes, it's worth it, but only at six, when the light changes.
No. Two hours for that is the biggest letdown of the week.

items.situation: Name a place that turned out to be completely different from what you expected -- in either direction.
tips: The little museum turned out to be a hidden gem.
The famous market turned out to be one of the worst afternoons of the trip.

items.situation: You need the English name of a place and it will not come. Describe it instead, so I can guess.
tips: It's the place where you go up and see the whole city at once.
It's the kind of place that looks great online and is empty inside.
